title: Fix dashboard pool summary deferred slot usage
body:
Fixes #55734

## What changed

The dashboard Pool Summary now aggregates `deferred_slots` into the usage bar only for pools where `include_deferred` is enabled.

I also added focused regression coverage for:
- individual pool cards, where non-consuming deferred tasks remain secondary information below the bar
- dashboard aggregation, where deferred slots from non-counting pools do not inflate total usage
- mixed pools, where only counting pools contribute deferred usage to the dashboard bar

## Before

The dashboard summary added every pool's `deferred_slots` to the visual usage bar, regardless of whether that pool was configured to count deferred tasks against its slots. That made a pool with open slots plus a non-consuming deferred task look like it had more used capacity than it really did.

For the issue case, this could make `128` open slots plus `1` deferred task appear as `129` slots represented in the dashboard bar, even when deferred tasks did not consume pool slots.

## Now

The dashboard aggregate skips `deferred_slots` for pools where `include_deferred=false`. Those deferred tasks are still visible on individual pool cards as secondary information below the bar, preserving visibility without treating them as consumed capacity.

When `include_deferred=true`, deferred tasks continue to render inside the bar and link to the deferred task-instance filter, because those tasks do consume pool slots for that pool.

## Impact

The dashboard now matches pool-slot semantics:
- `include_deferred=false`: deferred tasks are visible, but do not increase displayed bar usage
- `include_deferred=true`: deferred tasks are included in the displayed usage bar

This removes the misleading visual signal while preserving the existing pool-card behavior and deferred-task navigation for pools that count deferred tasks.

## Screenshots

Dashboard smoke check from localhost: one non-counting deferred pool plus one counting deferred pool renders as `255` open and `1` deferred, rather than counting both deferred tasks in the bar.

![Dashboard Pool Summary smoke check](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Vamsi-klu/airflow/codex/55734-pr-artifacts/screenshots/airflow-55734-dashboard-pool-summary.png)

Pool cards smoke check from localhost: `default_pool` shows `Deferred: 1` below the bar because `include_deferred=false`; `counting_pool` shows deferred inside the bar because `include_deferred=true`.

![Pool cards deferred slot behavior](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Vamsi-klu/airflow/codex/55734-pr-artifacts/screenshots/airflow-55734-pools-cards.png)

## Validation

- `corepack pnpm@10.24.0 --config.verify-deps-before-run=false test PoolBar PoolSummary`
- `corepack pnpm@10.24.0 --config.verify-deps-before-run=false lint`
- `corepack pnpm@10.24.0 --config.verify-deps-before-run=false build`
- `prek run --from-ref upstream/main --stage pre-commit`
- `prek run --from-ref upstream/main --stage manual`
- Rendered smoke check with a static local UI and mock API:
  - dashboard showed `255` open and `1` deferred for one non-counting deferred pool plus one counting deferred pool
  - `/pools` showed only the counting pool linking its deferred bar segment
  - browser console had no errors during the rendered checks
